result.brief: 提出 B-MIM，通过降低全局语义对齐、偏向局部 patch 重建改进 iBOT 式掩码图像建模，提升细粒度解剖结构的自监督表征泛化能力。
result.reason: B-MIM modifies masked image modeling (iBOT) pretraining to bias encoders toward local patch reconstruction, a self-supervised visual representation contribution transferable to video/visual representation learning.
